style.styleTitle: The White Company Christmas Mini Baubles
style.toneOfVoice: Vintage-inspired small-tree set. Made from glass. Handmade in India. Designed to dress our 3.5ft tree. A collection that sets the scene for a magical Christmas. Our mixed baubles are handmade – mouth-blown by artisans in India from glass. They come in a set of 24 and include four different designs: a clear glass pinecone, flocked chocolate-brown, white glass and a ribbed mercury onion. Detailed with an antiqued metal cap and soft grey velvet tie, they’re just the right size to decorate our 3.5ft tree, or to be styled with other ornaments on larger trees. This piece is crafted by hand. Variations in design may occur.
